# Vikas Surani

> Vikas Surani is the Global Vice President at Mastek and a TEDx speaker on AI-led enterprise transformation, leadership and technology strategy. He is based in Ahmedabad, India.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.vikassurani.com/): Overview of Vikas Surani's role at Mastek, TEDx talk, and areas of focus in AI-led transformation and leadership.
- [About](https://www.vikassurani.com/about): Vikas Surani's background — engineering degree, MBA, IIM Ahmedabad senior management programme, and career from Rajkot to enterprise transformation leadership at Mastek.
- [Speaker](https://www.vikassurani.com/speaker): Speaking profile for keynotes, panels, workshops and university sessions on AI transformation, leadership, and innovation. Includes past engagements and speaking formats.
- [Advisory](https://www.vikassurani.com/advisory): Paid one-on-one advisory conversations on career, AI strategy, and leadership, where 100% of the contribution is donated to a named education-focused cause each quarter.
- [Write](https://www.vikassurani.com/write): Essays, field notes and talk write-ups by Vikas Surani on AI transformation, leadership and technology, published on a biweekly newsletter called Being Learner.
- [Contact](https://www.vikassurani.com/contact): Contact form and direct details for booking Vikas Surani for keynotes, panels, advisory hours or campus sessions.
